values.description: Base URL of the ProxyPay API server. Change to your deployed URL if not running locally.
JWT access token — auto-populated by step 1.1 (Login). Do not edit manually.
Your user ID — auto-populated by step 1.1 or 1.3.
Your Stellar wallet address — auto-populated by step 1.3 (Get profile).
KYC applicant ID — auto-populated by step 2.1 (Create applicant).
KYC workflow run ID — auto-populated by step 2.3 (Start workflow).
Optional: your KYC_DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_ID from .env. Leave blank to use the server default.
Deposit transaction ID — auto-populated by step 3.1 (Deposit).
Withdrawal transaction ID — auto-populated by step 4.1 (Withdraw).
